results.title: Optical Components and Materials XXIII, Conference Details
results.content: Areas of research that are particularly active include high-power fiber lasers, switches, filters, ultra-short-pulse fiber lasers, as well as material research in rare-earth-doped glasses, semiconductors, and nano-particles for enabling innovative photonic devices. We compare the emissions of the Photonic Crystal Fibers with each laser source based on average power, spectra, and optical efficiency. This study aims to assess the effectiveness of metal coating on rare-earth-doped fibers for improved thermal management, which is essential for reliable operation and power scaling to the kW level of fiber lasers utilising the cladding-pumped architectures, particularly in the eye-safe 1.55-2μm spectral range. We present the design and performance of a polarization maintaining (PM) nanosecond pulsed fiber laser (PFL) system operating at 2121 nm, developed for coherent LiDAR and gas sensing applications. Design and performance of a high-power PM Raman fiber amplifier for single frequency lasers in the 1145nm band. We present the development and characterization of a high-power, continuous-wave (CW), single-frequency, polarization-maintaining (PM) Raman fiber amplifier (RFA) designed for operation in the 1140–1155 nm band.
